import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Calculate total spending per customer
df['TotalSpending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])

# Calculate age from Year_Birth
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a comprehensive figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], 
                     c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', alpha=0.6, s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Customer Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=10)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Spending by Category - Bar chart
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_totals = df[spending_categories].sum()
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(category_labels))
ax2.barh(category_labels, category_totals, color=colors)
ax2.set_xlabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Total Spending by Category', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Education level distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
education_counts = df['Education'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(education_counts.values, labels=education_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))
ax3.set_title('Education Level Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Marital Status distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
ax4.bar(range(len(marital_counts)), marital_counts.values, 
        color=sns.color_palette('muted', len(marital_counts)))
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(marital_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(marital_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Age distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax5.hist(df['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax5.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Purchase channels comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_totals = df[purchase_channels].sum()
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
ax6.bar(channel_labels, channel_totals, color=sns.color_palette('Set1', len(channel_labels)))
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Purchases', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Purchase Channels Comparison', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Kids at home vs Spending
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
df['TotalKids'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
kids_spending = df.groupby('TotalKids')['TotalSpending'].mean()
ax7.plot(kids_spending.index, kids_spending.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='coral')
ax7.set_xlabel('Total Kids at Home', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Kids at Home vs Average Spending', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Campaign Response Rates
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
response_rates = [df[camp].sum() / len(df) * 100 for camp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last']
ax8.bar(campaign_labels, response_rates, color=sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(campaign_labels)))
ax8.set_ylabel('Response Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Campaign Response Rates', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Dashboard - Comprehensive Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
